summary: A teacher on her last day walks into her emptied classroom after three decades and cries, then her principal hugs her.
realLife: A local news story describes a retiring sign language teacher entering her room for the last time, finding few traces of her 30-plus years, and weeping; her principal hugged her and the senior class president had thanked her at graduation the day before.
sources: WPTV news story, last day of school for a retiring high school teacher: https://wptv.com/news/education/last-day-of-school-brings-fond-memories-for-retiring-william-t-dwyer-high-school-teacher
inGame: Job-ended event for retirement, tenure from the job record (employer, position, workplace, pay, tenure) in the jobs module, and the player's tie to the person (coworker or former student).
